install.description: Install a module from provider or local build package (@build)
case_pros: 安裝新模組能力至環境中
本地模組自引用調試: install <mod>@build --force (不更新無關模組)
case_cons: 🚨 嚴禁未經開發者指示在日常開發中重複安裝或重裝全部模組

update.description: Update installed module(s) to latest version
case_pros: 升級已安裝之模組版本
case_cons: 🚨 嚴禁在未獲升級指示前擅自更新

remove.description: Remove an installed module from environment
case_cons: 🚨 嚴禁擅自移除 core 或使用中之依賴模組

list.description: List all installed modules, versions and providers
case_pros: 檢視當前環境已安裝之模組清冊與版本

status.description: Health check and runtime diagnostic report
case_pros: 環境健康診斷與自我修復檢查
重新聚合 contributes 並觸發模組 on_reload Hook

rollback.description: Revert environment to the previous snapshot state
case_pros: 當前環境損毀時回滾至前一快照
case_cons: 🚨 嚴禁未經確認擅自回滾環境

uri.description: Resolve canonical semantic URI to physical path
case_pros: 動態解析語意 URI (如 python yscb.py uri resolve project://AGENTS.md)
